_README: Declared expectations for The Scaffolder's Playbook build. THIS FILE IS THE REFERENCE; the tests assert the built artifacts against it. Owner-reviewable. When a value here changes deliberately, change it here FIRST, then rebuild. A test failure means either the build broke or this file is stale - decide which, never silently edit to match.
_naming: Resolve this file by SELECT_LATEST on build_expectations_YYYYMMDD_vN.json within the Process folder - NEVER by a remembered fileId, which goes stale on every revision. The two undated build_expectations.json files in Process are superseded and should be archived.
_note_text_layer_required: Text-layer only. Strings that exist ONLY inside baked images (e.g. 'Fifty tested patterns' on the back cover) must NOT go here - they are unfindable by text extraction. Those belong to the OCR check (pdf.back_cover_count_word, test P06).
text_layer_required: For a diagnostic: nobody reaches for one
a reading order for a catalog, not an assessment

_note_legal: Legal front matter is asserted separately because it is the class of content that went missing undetected: 3,565 B of copyright, licence grant and disclaimers lived only in the disposable assembled file, while the shard control total reconciled perfectly throughout because that content was never in its scope. RULES: (1) every probe must exist verbatim in the canonical frontmatter shard - never type these from memory, two of three hand-written probes were wrong on 30 Jul; (2) the test asserts they survived into the BUILT PDF, because the artifact readers receive is what matters; (3) comparison is hyphen-insensitive - the PDF exporter renders 'non-commercial' as 'noncommercial'.
